parameters.query:
-- One run at a time: take the lock unless another run took it in the last 5
-- minutes (a run that died leaves it to expire).
INSERT INTO audit.relay_state (name, value) VALUES ('w3b-lock', now()::text)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = now()
  WHERE audit.relay_state.value::timestamptz < now() - interval '5 minutes'
RETURNING value AS locked_at;

-- Mapped messages up to 7 days old, each with its live (not undone) decision.
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
         'map_id', m.id, 'channel', m.channel, 'ts', m.ts, 'kind', m.kind, 'test_id', m.test_id, 'ticket', m.ticket,
         'nightly_run_id', m.nightly_run_id::text, 'class', m.class, 'thread_ts', m.thread_ts,
         'source_run_id', m.source_run_id::text, 'flow_id', m.flow_id, 'bug_title', m.bug_title,
         'jira_wait_until', (SELECT to_char(q.not_before AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') FROM audit.deferred_requests q
                             WHERE q.action = 'jira-write' AND q.target = 'reaction-' || m.id AND q.done_at IS NULL LIMIT 1),
         'decision', CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE json_build_object(
           'id', d.id, 'action', d.action, 'state', d.state, 'actor_id', d.actor_id, 'actor_email', d.actor_email,
           'actor_name', d.actor_name, 'prompt_ts', d.prompt_ts) END) ORDER BY m.id), '[]') AS messages
FROM audit.message_map m
LEFT JOIN audit.reaction_decisions d ON d.map_id = m.id AND d.undone_at IS NULL
WHERE m.created_at > now() - interval '7 days';

parameters.query:
-- One live decision per message; a second reaction can't add another. Always
-- one row back (the new id, or null), so rows stay in line with decisions.
WITH saved AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.reaction_decisions (map_id, action, state, actor_id, actor_email, actor_name, jira_key, link, handled_at)
  VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, CASE WHEN $3 = 'handled' THEN now() END)
  ON CONFLICT (map_id) WHERE undone_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM saved) AS id;
UPDATE audit.reaction_decisions SET prompt_ts = $2 WHERE id = $1::bigint AND $3 = 'ignore' RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO audit.deferred_requests (action, workflow, target, payload, reason, not_before)
VALUES ('dispatch', 'quarantine', $1, $2::jsonb, 'retry', now())
ON CONFLICT (action, workflow, target) WHERE done_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

-- Quarantine requests that may be started now, oldest first (Story 5.6 rules).
SELECT id AS queue_id, target AS jira_key, payload FROM audit.deferred_requests
WHERE action = 'dispatch' AND workflow = 'quarantine' AND done_at IS NULL AND not_before <= now()
ORDER BY created_at, id;
